name: TypeScript · Round 1
domainSummary: A static type-checking layer for JavaScript that adds structural typing, inference, interfaces, unions, narrowing, generics, and compile-time validation while preserving JavaScript runtime interoperability.
evidenceBoundary: Do not form T or S letters, use the TypeScript logo, show code, or depict a compiler UI. Express typing and narrowing as fitted prismatic structure.

researchSources.title: TypeScript Handbook
researchSources.use: Official static checking and JavaScript interoperability context.
